result.summary: Found 4 issues: content is cut off at the right edge in horizontally scrolling sections, and category filter tabs are truncated at the screen edge, indicating layout/overflow problems.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section shows a third card (Trattoria Piccolo) cut off abruptly at the right edge of the screen with no clear scroll indicator or fade effect.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient overlay at the edge to indicate scrollability, or ensure cards are fully visible with proper peek amount.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) has an additional category cut off at the right edge, only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade gradient or arrow indicator to signal more scrollable content.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccolo' appears truncated ('Piccol') due to the card being cut off by the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Ensure text truncation uses ellipsis styling consistently, or adjust card width so text isn't awkwardly cut mid-word.

issues.description: The second promotional item below 'Popular right now' (pizza image with -20% badge) is cut off at the bottom of the visible screen with no clear indication of additional scrollable content beyond the fold.
issues.suggestion: Consider adding a visual cue (like a partial card reveal) to signal scrollability, or ensure consistent spacing so content isn't harshly clipped by the viewport.
